m3_smart.builder: a fresh Claude Code subagent with no access to any score (merge_inputs/ only). It wrote orchestrator.md and shared_context.md itself and spawned 3 sub-agents: aap2; icinga; cost+babylon+security.
m3_smart.wall_seconds_note: top-level agent, first to last message (08:56:24 to 09:45:59 UTC); the 3 sub-agents ran inside that window, in parallel
m3_smart.footnote: Measured, then priced. Token counts are summed from the per-message usage records in the four agent transcripts (the merger and its three sub-agents; 89 API messages, all claude-opus-5-5), kept in m3_smart_usage.json. A message is logged once per content block with cumulative usage, so each message is counted once, at its last record. The subagent harness reported 189,023 tokens for the top-level merger alone; that figure excludes the sub-agents and does not separate cache reads, which is why it differs from the 10.15M total here. Dollars are an estimate: tokens x Anthropic list price for Claude Opus 5.5 ($4 input, $20 output, $0.20 cache read, $5 5-minute cache write per million tokens; no 1-hour writes occurred). The run went through the team gateway (served as aws/claude-opus-5-5), whose actual billed rate may differ from list price. 63% of the cost is output tokens.
